buildCommand: buildctl-daemonless.sh build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=/src/. --local dockerfile=/src/controller --opt platform=linux/{{.Arch}} --opt build-arg:GOLANG_IMAGE=docker.io/library/golang@sha256:08bcb99a38f85a265f9a93d1d3323e2440eec333380f3ea26ee0dec9264bb41c --opt "build-arg:BUILD_VERSION=$BUILD_VERSION" --opt "build-arg:GIT_VERSION=$GIT_VERSION" --opt "build-arg:SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" --output type=oci,dest=/src/bin/nvke-controller-image-{{.Arch}}.oci.tar,oci-mediatypes=true

export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=vendor
make -C cli build NVKECTL_TREE=clean
vendorCommand:
export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=
# The source-owned charts module has no dependencies or go.sum.
test ! -e controller/deploy/charts/go.sum
pins="$(sha256sum cli/go.mod cli/go.sum controller/api/go.mod controller/api/go.sum controller/deploy/charts/go.mod management-engine/go.mod management-engine/go.sum)"
cd cli
timeout --kill-after=10s 540s go mod download
GOPROXY=off timeout --kill-after=10s 60s go mod verify
GOPROXY=off timeout --kill-after=10s 180s go mod vendor
cd ..
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum --quiet -c -
test ! -e controller/deploy/charts/go.sum
